source_name: CBCG — Finansijski izvještaji banaka (bank financial statements repository)
why_relevant: Compulsory central repository of per-bank audited annual and unaudited quarterly financial statements (balance sheet, P&L, cash flow, equity, notes, management commentary, auditor opinion). Page content observed listing PDF annual reports and ZIP quarterly filings for individual banks with coverage roughly 2011-2025. This is the single richest per-institution disclosure archive in Montenegro.

source_name: CBCG — Bilansi stanja i bilansi uspjeha banaka (bank balance sheets & income statements)
why_relevant: Standardised supervisory-template balance sheet and income statement data per bank, published by the regulator itself — far easier to normalise into a time series than PDF annual reports, and comparable across all licensed banks.

source_name: CBCG — Registar banaka (register of licensed banks)
why_relevant: Authoritative pointer to the full population of licensed banks (observed ~12 active: CKB, Hipotekarna, Prva banka, Erste, NLB, Addiko, Universal Capital Bank, Lovćen banka, Zapad banka, Ziraat Montenegro, Adriatic Bank, Podgorička banka). Each entry has its own sub-page with licence details and links onward to that bank's own IR/website — the seed list for every downstream actor-level crawl.

source_name: CBCG — Registar platnih institucija i njihovih agenata (payment institutions register)
why_relevant: Statutory register of licensed payment institutions and their agents under the Zakon o platnom prometu — the definitive map of non-bank PSP competition in Montenegro and a seed list for company-level tracking.

source_name: CBCG — Registar institucija za elektronski novac i njihovih agenata (e-money institutions register)
why_relevant: Definitive list of licensed e-money issuers and their agents — the fintech/EMI layer of the Montenegrin payments market.

source_name: CBCG — Registar platnih sistema (payment systems register)
why_relevant: Lists the payment systems authorised/operated in Montenegro (RTGS, DNS, and any card/instant schemes) — infrastructure-level map for payments market entry analysis.

source_name: CBCG — Registri (payments registers hub)
why_relevant: Single hub linking all payment-side registers; the most stable crawl entry point if individual register URLs change.

source_name: CBCG — Spisak platnih institucija i institucija za elektronski novac kojima je oduzeto odobrenje (withdrawn authorisations)
why_relevant: Negative-signal source: licence revocations reveal market exits, enforcement actions and consolidation that press releases often omit.

source_name: CBCG — Statistika Platnog sistema Centralne banke Crne Gore (RTGS/DNS/IPS payment system statistics)
why_relevant: Observed page publishes transaction counts and values split RTGS vs DNS, average daily volumes, system availability, and (per the page) IPS/instant payments data from July 2026 — the core payments-volume time series for Montenegro, with monthly PDF annexes ('Prilog').

source_name: CBCG — Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu (payment services & e-money data)
why_relevant: ECB-style payment-services statistics (cards, terminals/POS-ATM, credit transfers, direct debits, e-money) — the closest Montenegrin equivalent to ECB Payments Statistics and the key demand-side series for a payments-hardware/software vendor. URL inferred from the sibling-page structure observed on the payment statistics section; treat path as unverified.

source_name: CBCG — Statistika: Platni promet (statistical data section)
why_relevant: Statistics-department view of payment turnover, distinct from the operational payment-system page; part of the official statistics calendar so cadence is predictable.

source_name: CBCG — Monetarna i finansijska statistika / Monetarne finansijske institucije
why_relevant: Aggregate MFI balance sheet, deposits, loans and interest-rate series compiled on ECB/IMF methodology and published monthly — the backbone macro-banking dataset for sizing the Montenegrin banking market.

source_name: CBCG — Indikatori finansijske stabilnosti (financial soundness indicators)
why_relevant: IMF-style FSIs: capital adequacy, NPL ratio, ROA/ROE, liquidity — quantitative health metrics for the banking sector, comparable over time and across peers.

source_name: CBCG — Finansijska stabilnost: Pokazatelji i izvještaji
why_relevant: Financial-stability function's own indicator and report hub, including the annual Izvještaj o stabilnosti finansijskog sistema — narrative risk assessment of the banking and payments system.

source_name: CBCG — Financial Stability Report (EN)
why_relevant: English edition of the annual financial system stability report — analysis of threats, risks and vulnerabilities; usable directly without translation and easier to cite.

source_name: CBCG — Godišnji izvještaj / Izvještaj o radu CBCG (annual report on operations)
why_relevant: The central bank's own annual report: banking-sector aggregates (e.g. total bank assets, credit growth, NPL ratio), supervisory activity, SEPA/payments modernisation and EU-alignment progress. Strategic-context anchor for the whole cell. English edition also published.

source_name: CBCG — Makroekonomski izvještaj: godišnji i kvartalni izvještaj
why_relevant: Quarterly and annual macroeconomic reports containing a dedicated banking-sector chapter (assets, loans, deposits, rates) — the highest-frequency narrative source on sector trends between annual reports.

source_name: CBCG — Publikacije hub (redovne + ostale publikacije, incl. Governor's Report)
why_relevant: Master index of all CBCG regular and occasional publications (Governor's monthly report, inflation report, macro risk analyses, research papers). Best single crawl root for publication discovery, and the Governor's monthly report gives near-real-time sector commentary.

source_name: CBCG — Saopštenja / Aktuelno (press releases and Council session communiqués)
why_relevant: Council-session communiqués announce licence grants/withdrawals, new regulations (e.g. Odluka o adekvatnosti kapitala banke), SEPA/IPS milestones and headline sector figures — the earliest public signal of regulatory change affecting banks and PSPs.

source_name: CBCG — Pregledi tarifa pružalaca platnih usluga / Tarife banaka (payment-service tariff comparison)
why_relevant: Regulator-hosted, per-bank tariff sheets for payment services and consumer payment accounts — a rare, directly comparable pricing dataset across every bank and PSP in the market. Highly valuable for competitive pricing analysis of card/POS/acquiring fees.

source_name: CBCG — Pružaoci finansijskih usluga (leasing, faktoring, MFI, kreditno-garantni fondovi) registers
why_relevant: Registers and financial reports for non-bank credit providers (microcredit financial institutions, leasing, factoring, credit-guarantee funds) — adjacent supervised population that also buys banking/payments technology.

source_name: CBCG — Centralni registar transakcionih računa pravnih lica i preduzetnika (CRTR)
why_relevant: Central register of corporate transaction accounts (and blocked-account lists). Indirectly reveals which banks hold which corporate relationships and market-share shifts in corporate banking; blocked-entity data is a credit-risk signal.

source_name: CBCG — Usluge kreditnog registra (credit register services)
why_relevant: Describes the CBCG credit register (kreditni registar) — its scope, reporting obligations and services. Useful for understanding what data banks must submit (a driver of reporting/RegTech demand) even though record-level data is restricted.

source_name: CBCG — Regulativa / Podzakonski akti: Platni promet i platni sistemi; Kontrola banaka
why_relevant: Full text of secondary legislation that creates the disclosure obligations this cell depends on — notably the Odluka o adekvatnosti kapitala banke (Pillar 3 / objelodanjivanje), the Odluka o javnom objelodanjivanju podataka kreditnih institucija, and the Odluka o izvještajima o platnom prometu (monthly reporting). Tells you what must exist, where, and how often.

source_name: CBCG — Javni registri i javne evidencije (public registers index, FOI section)
why_relevant: Statutory index of every public register and record CBCG maintains, published under the freedom-of-information regime — the most complete single enumeration of CBCG-held datasets, including ones not surfaced in the main navigation. Also the entry point for FOI (pristup informacijama) requests where data is not published.

source_name: CBCG — Priznate rejting agencije (recognised ECAIs)
why_relevant: Lists external credit assessment institutions recognised for capital-adequacy purposes — a pointer to third-party rating sources whose Montenegrin bank reports become an independent credibility cross-check.

source_name: CBCG — Bankarski sistem / Kontrolna funkcija section root (incl. banks in bankruptcy/liquidation)
why_relevant: Root of the supervision branch: register of banks, banks in bankruptcy/liquidation, financial statements, balance/income data, credit register. Most robust crawl entry point for the whole supervisory-disclosure cluster given CBCG's unstable URL path prefixes.

source_name: Crnogorska komercijalna banka (CKB, OTP Group) – Finansijski i ostali izvještaji
why_relevant: Largest Montenegrin bank by assets; self-publishes audited standalone and consolidated financial statements, annual management reports and public disclosure documents. PDFs sit under /upload/ paths and are the richest primary earnings evidence for the ME market leader.
